subject: Unexplained embed-unit spike on June 2 — usage log request & VAT path
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlashealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: AtlasHealth Billing <billing@atlashealth.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Sudden embed-unit spike on June 2 — sample attached / VAT concern

Marcus —

We just received the June invoice (INV-6129) and see a ~7.8x jump in embed units on June 2 relative to our 7‑day baseline. We were in the middle of a search-index migration that day but the pattern looks like a burst of near-duplicate calls for the same payload (see attached usage-sample-20270602.csv). The jump pushed us over our monthly threshold and created an unexpected EU VAT reclaim question for our finance team.

Immediate asks:
- Can you confirm whether these are counted as unique embed units vs retries/duplicates?
- We need the raw request IDs + timestamps and the server-side dedupe flags for June 2 (UTC) to share with our auditors.
- If this is on Redwood (sampling window/ingest duplication), what is your VAT treatment recommendation while we investigate — do you suggest a provisional credit or invoice hold?

We’ve attached a small sample extract and the invoice. Please loop in whoever you need from billing/ops — we’re on a tight month‑end timeline.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Patel
Head of Platform Ops | AtlasHealth
samir.patel@atlashealth.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachment: usage-sample-20270602.csv (sample of requestid, path, timestamp, token_count)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 02 Jun 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden embed-unit spike on June 2 — sample attached / VAT concern

Samir — thanks for the heads up and the sample. Looping in Ben from Billing and Grace from Customer Success so we can triage the root cause and handle the invoice impact. Quick confirmation checklist from us so we can act fast:

1) Can you confirm the migration start/end UTC window and whether any retry middleware was toggled at your side (e.g., SQS replay, CDN retries)?
2) Do you have the full request-id list (not just the sample) or a BigQuery/export link — the sample helps but we need the complete set to match on our side.
3) Please grant read-only access to the HubSpot ticket referenced in related_links (or paste the ticket id) so we can attach our findings.

Our proposed immediate steps:
- Ben will request a per-request export for 2027-06-02 from our metering pipeline (request-ids, model, token_count, embed_unit_flag, dedupe_marker).
- We can place INV-6129 on a provisional hold for 5 business days while we validate. If we confirm a Redwood-side counting anomaly we will propose a retroactive credit and correct VAT treatment.

Ben/Grace, can you confirm the ETA on the export and whether provisional hold is acceptable? Samir, we’ll aim to get the export within 48 hours.

Regards,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Grace Oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Sudden embed-unit spike on June 2 — sample attached / VAT concern

Thanks Marcus — taking ownership of the usage export. A few technical clarifications from Billing/Telemetry side so we pull the right slices:

- On Redwood we tag embed operations with embed_unit_flag and also emit a dedupe_marker when the runtime detects a repeated request within the same prefix-KV window. The invoice counts embed units after de-duplication in production; we’ll double-check why your sample appears duplicated.

Questions for AtlasHealth (Samir):
- Can you confirm whether the sample rows have identical request payload hashes? If so, are they 1:1 retries or parallel fan-outs?
- Do you use streaming embedding (long-lived stream) or discrete HTTP embed calls during the migration? Streaming can produce repeated small batches that inflate unit counts in some artifact cases.
- Please provide your timezone-normalized migration markers — we want to query the metering database for 2027-06-02T00:00:00Z through 2027-06-03T00:00:00Z and will join on request_id + payload_hash.

Operational plan and timeline:
- I’ll run the export and initial join today (target within 24 hours) and share a csv of matched vs unmatched request_ids.
- If we find >1% of counted embed units are attributable to server-side duplication, we will propose a provisional credit calculation. Attached is a conservative credit calc template I’ll fill out after the export (provisional_credit_calc.xlsx).
- For VAT: if we issue a retroactive credit that affects billed amounts for EU entities, we will also provide a corrected VAT statement. That said, we need to confirm who taxed the invoice (AtlasHealth EU entity?) — Samir, please confirm the billing entity so we can route VAT corrections correctly.

I am opening an internal ticket and will update HubSpot. Marcus — please keep the invoice on hold while we validate.

Ben Carter
Billing Ops — Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai

Attachment: provisional_credit_calc.xlsx (blank calc template, will be populated after export)

Ben/Marcus —

Thanks for the quick triage and for keeping the invoice on hold. I’ve attached a signed dispute hold confirmation from our procurement team (signed-dispute-hold.pdf) and included the full request-id export link: https://storage.atlashealth.com/exports/atlas-usage-20270602.csv. The billing entity is AtlasHealth EU Ltd (VAT ID: EU987654321).

Notes from our side: during the migration we did a staged replay (parallel workers) which may have created near-duplicate payloads — I’ll share the orchestration config tomorrow. However, our initial read suggests the majority of the incr is coming from two clustered 10‑minute windows where request_ids repeat with identical payload hashes. We appreciate a careful match — if Redwood confirms server-side de‑duplication missed these we will expect a retroactive credit and corrected VAT paperwork.

Can you provide an ETA for the matched export and provisional credit calc? Our finance team needs guidance by next Wed (2027-06-16) for month‑end close.

Samir
